title: Unlock an account and reset a password
body: Verify identity with two factors. Unlock in the directory admin console. Force a password reset at next sign-in. Never read a password over the phone.

title: Re-register MFA for a lost or new phone
body: Verify identity, revoke old MFA methods, send a temporary access pass, ask the user to enrol the new device.

title: Grant access to a shared drive or application
body: Confirm written manager approval. Add the user to the correct security group, never directly to the resource.

title: Docking station and external monitor troubleshooting
body: Update dock firmware, reseat cables, test a known-good monitor, check display settings, replace dock if needed.

title: Swollen laptop battery: safety procedure
body: Stop using the device immediately, unplug it, do not charge. Arrange a hardware swap and hazardous disposal.

title: VPN connection troubleshooting
body: Check internet connectivity, client version and certificate expiry. Try alternate gateway. Collect client logs.

title: DNS resolution failures for internal sites
body: Flush DNS cache, confirm DNS servers via ipconfig, test nslookup against internal resolvers, escalate to NetOps.

title: Application crashes after update
body: Clear the local cache, repair the installation, roll back to the previous version if the vendor confirms a bug.

title: Software install and license requests
body: Confirm license approval, deploy via the software centre, never install unlicensed software manually.

title: HyFlex room audio: remote students can't hear
body: Check the room PC audio output device, ceiling mic mute status, and the DSP preset. Run the room audio test.

title: Classroom projector or display shows no input
body: Select the correct input on the touch panel, reseat HDMI at the lectern, power-cycle the projector.

title: Outlook not receiving mail
body: Check mailbox quota, rules, and connection status. Test in webmail to isolate client vs server.

title: Shared mailbox and distribution list access
body: Confirm owner approval, add via the admin centre, allow up to an hour for the mailbox to appear.

title: Suspected phishing: first response
body: Do not delete the email. Report it with the phishing button. If credentials were entered, reset the password, revoke sessions and open a security incident. Security incidents are handled by Security Operations only.

title: Lost or stolen device with sensitive data
body: Remote-wipe via device management, disable the account's sessions, notify privacy office per policy.

title: Runbook: SQS dead-letter queue not empty
body: Inspect DLQ messages to find the failure reason. Fix the bug or bad data. Redrive messages to the source queue only after the fix is deployed. Redrive is a change and needs change approval.

title: Runbook: SQS queue backlog growing
body: Check processor Lambda errors, throttles and concurrency limits. Check downstream DynamoDB throttling.

title: Runbook: Lambda function errors
body: Open CloudWatch Logs for the function, find the stack trace, check the latest deploy, roll back if needed.

title: Runbook: API Gateway 5xx errors
body: Check integration Lambda errors and timeouts, recent deploys, and throttling settings. Customer-facing: treat as P1.

title: Runbook: AWS budget alert
body: Open Cost Explorer filtered by project tag, find the service driving cost, check for runaway loops or load tests.
